subject.title: Feature Request: Disable exec command credential masking / secret replacement

question: Should OpenClaw support any exec/tool credential-redaction opt-out, and if so should it be a narrow privileged ephemeral debug path rather than a persistent tools.exec credentialGuard setting?
rationale: The requested behavior changes a documented credential safety boundary and the current source does not prove the reported shell-command mutation, so automation cannot choose the product/security boundary safely.

options.title: Approve narrow raw-debug path
options.body: Define a privileged, local-only, ephemeral raw-payload/debug mechanism excluded from persistence, UI events, diagnostics, and shared channel displays.

options.title: Track config opt-out only in the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this issue open only for the pre-shell repro while handling persistent tool-payload opt-out discussion in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98902.

options.title: Reject redaction opt-outs
options.body: Declare forced redaction on safety-boundary surfaces permanent and ask for concrete repros only when command execution itself is mutated.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow raw-debug path
recommendation.body: Define a privileged, local-only, ephemeral raw-payload/debug mechanism excluded from persistence, UI events, diagnostics, and shared channel displays.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc already gave the clearest prior safety-boundary decision on the same-direction raw tool-payload opt-out PR.
